news.headline: JP Morgan keeps Overweight on Forgent, lowers price target to $35 from $49
news.summary: On the eve of fiscal Q1 results, JP Morgan kept its Overweight rating but cut its target to $35 from $49, tracking the roughly 40% one-month slide in the shares. The new target still sits well above the low-$20s share price.

news.headline: Forgent Power Solutions (FPS) is soaring double digits ahead of earnings
news.summary: FPS rose about 16% on November 9 to close at $22.60, rebounding from a new 52-week low set the previous Friday as investors bought the dip. The bounce came ahead of the November 12 fiscal Q1 report, which the company has already said will beat the top of its revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance.

news.headline: Roth/MKM Starts Forgent Power Solutions (FPS) at Buy
news.summary: Roth/MKM initiated coverage with a Buy rating just ahead of fiscal Q1 results. The stock had hit a new 52-week low the day before, after a roughly 33% pullback.

news.headline: Forgent Power Solutions shares gap down, slide toward 52-week low
news.summary: FPS opened sharply lower on Nov 4 and kept falling into a new 52-week low on Nov 5. The selling followed the October CFO change and continued worries about valuation ahead of fiscal Q1 results.

news.headline: Forgent Power Solutions to invest $3 million in downtown Columbus office, add 85 jobs
news.summary: Forgent will open a 90,000 sq ft office in Columbus, Ohio, for customer service, project management, supply chain and corporate functions, creating 85 jobs. Ohio granted a 10-year job creation tax credit.

news.headline: Clear Street initiates Forgent Power Solutions with Buy rating, $58 target
news.summary: Clear Street initiated coverage with a Buy rating and a $58 price target, adding to the bullish sell-side coverage after the CFO-driven selloff.

news.headline: Forgent Announces CFO Transition
news.summary: CFO Ryan Fiedler stepped down about a year after the IPO and moved into a consulting role. EVP of Finance Amy Ard succeeds him. The company said the departure was not due to any disagreement, but the stock fell about 11% that day.

catalysts.label: Fiscal Q1 2027 results
catalysts.detail: Results before the market opens, call at 11:00 a.m. ET. Revenue and adj. EBITDA are pre-announced above the high end of guidance ($445-465M revenue, $90-100M adj. EBITDA). The focus is on bookings, backlog and whether the FY2027 guide ($2.4-2.6B revenue, $575-625M adj. EBITDA, adj. EPS $1.26-1.40) is raised. Options implied a move of about 11%.

catalysts.label: Columbus office ramp
catalysts.detail: New 90,000 sq ft Columbus, Ohio office adding 85 jobs in support functions.

catalysts.label: Tijuana Powertrain expansion online
catalysts.detail: Expected to raise total revenue capacity to about $5.8B.

pulse: Forgent reports fiscal Q1 2027 before the open on November 12 (call 11:00 a.m. ET), having already said revenue and adj. EBITDA beat the top of guidance on the back of a record ~$3.0B backlog. The stock is down about 40% in a month on the October CFO exit and AI-capex sentiment worries, trading in the low $20s; on November 11 JP Morgan stayed Overweight but cut its target to $35 from $49, while Clear Street (Buy/$58) and Roth/MKM (Buy) recently initiated. The key test is bookings momentum and whether the FY2027 guide ($2.4-2.6B revenue, $575-625M adj. EBITDA) is raised.
